title: Petroleum Retail Marketing Sites and Franchise Acts repealed; Oilcode introduced
summary: From 1 March 2007 the limits on oil majors running retail sites directly were repealed and a mandatory Oilcode governed fuel reselling.

commenced.what: Sites and Franchise Acts repealed; Oilcode commenced

direction_rationale: Removing limits on direct retailing by refiners allows more vertical integration, which can lower costs or foreclose independents.
